messages:
mira-peopleops: Heads-up: three midcycle requests for IC -> hybrid IC/EM conversions. Managers are asking what exact evidence, how to pick effective dates, and whether backpay is standard. Anyone run through this recently?
jordan-manager: Ran one two sprints ago. Payroll wanted an exact effective date and a manager90signed justification. Also note whether the new role includes direct reports or just mentorship.
ashley-ic: From the IC side, keep the evidence tight: 3 impact bullets, a short note on people-lead activities, and links to two outcomes. No need for huge attachments.
kevin-hrbp: Quick comp rules: base bumps can be paid retro only if approval clears before the payroll cutoff for that cycle. If approval is post-cutoff, base change applies next pay period; backpay may be processed in the subsequent payroll run if approved. Backpay = pro-rated from effective date to the pay period end.
mira-peopleops: Can someone paste a minimal checklist managers can attach so requests don't get kicked back?
olivia-peopleops: Yep 97 here's the short bundle we accept (PDF preferred):

``
1) Manager justification (150-350 chars) & Workday manager approval click
2) 3 concise impact bullets showing expanded scope (include triage/people work)
3) Recent performance snapshot (rating or 1-line manager summary)
4) Tiny org-chart image (old vs new span)
5) Proposed comp table: current base, proposed base, % uplift, equity note; proposed effective date (YYYY-MM-DD)
6) Indicate if role will be backfilled and provide budget owner if yes
```

olivia-peopleops: Also: if uplift >15% or equity-only substitution, it routes to Comp Committee; expect extra review time.
peopleops-bot: Link: Off-cycle leveling form (Workday) https://workday.redwood/internal/forms/offcycle - missing this blocks approval.
jordan-manager: For hybrid role evidence, emphasize mentorship, 1:1s, and hiring mentorship rather than only PRs. We had one denied because it was code-only.
ashley-ic: Where should manager sign the justification? Inline Workday approval is ideal; attach the justification PDF in the form comments if you want a written copy.
kevin-hrbp: SLA: our baseline is 7 business days for People Ops + Payroll if the packet is complete. If escalated to Comp Committee, add ~7-10 business days. If a request hits payroll after cutoff, the effective date stands but pay changes apply next cycle; backpay is queued once approval is final.
mira-peopleops: Template for manager justification to paste in Workday comments?
olivia-peopleops: Use this short template: "[Employee] is recommended for leveling to [Level] due to: 1) clear scope expansion (teams/projects), 2) documented people leadership (mentorship/hiring), 3) measurable outcomes (links). Proposed effective date: YYYY-MM-DD. Manager: [Name]."
jordan-manager: Helpful. Also, add a 1-line note if the change is due to promotion vs role redefinition. That helped payroll code the transaction correctly.
mira-peopleops: One more: are equity-only midcycle adjustments acceptable if headcount budget is tight?
kevin-hrbp: They are possible but uncommon. Equity-only requests still require Committee sign-off and a compensation rationale (why base not increased). Include a note on retention risk and market data.
ashley-ic: Thanks 97 I'll assemble packets for my three folks today and submit the Workday forms. cc: @jordan-manager
mira-peopleops: Awesome. I'll put a trimmed checklist in the manager handbook and link the form. If anyone wants a quick review before submission, ping me and I can skim the packet. :raised_hands:
